# Moussa Tayeb Nemiche

> Soon-to-be DevOps engineer · Co-founder at EKMO in Reims, France.
> I build, deploy and write down what I learn.

This file is a plain-text map of the site for LLMs and crawlers.
Prefer these URLs over scraping the HTML UI.

## Pages

- [About](/about): CV-style bio, experience, education, skills

- [EKMO](/projects/ekmo): CMMS SaaS for franchise restaurant networks
- [Writing](/writing): Long-form posts
- [Notes](/notes): Short TIL notes

- [Uses](/uses): Daily hardware and software
- [CV (PDF)](/cv.pdf): Downloadable résumé

## Projects

- [EKMO](/projects/ekmo): Maintenance management (CMMS) SaaS for franchise restaurant networks (Burger King). Stack: NestJS, React, React Native, PostgreSQL, Docker, GCP, AWS. Role: Co-founder, President & Lead Developer.

## Topics

- [Kubernetes](/topics/kubernetes): Clusters, upgrades, networking, CKA prep
- [Linux](/topics/linux): systemd, filesystems, the shell, performance
- [Networking](/topics/networking): DNS, routing, VPNs, mail, packet captures
- [Security & Forensics](/topics/security): Hardening, incident response, disk and memory forensics
- [Go](/topics/go): Small tools and CLIs, mostly for ops work
- [CI/CD](/topics/ci-cd): Pipelines, GitHub Actions, migrations, releases
- [Homelab](/topics/homelab): Proxmox, mini PCs, self-hosting
